messages:
Alex: FYI customer reported SSE stream closing mid-response when they switch from office WiFi -> cellular. Partial JSON payload then socket gone. Happens ~10-12s into stream.
Julie (Support): Reported error code on client was ECONNRESET and the app shows 'stream closed by peer'. Customer says tokens billed up to truncated output.
Maya: Do we have proxy timeouts in front of streaming endpoints for that account? :thinking_face:
Devon: On mobile the app uses fetch + EventSource fallback. We saw flaky behavior when network type changes. Might be NAT/port rebinds.
Alex: Customer provided a pcap + client logs. Attaching snippet: ```
[2026-03-16T15:03:12.123Z] SSE chunk: {"delta":"Hello wo"
[2026-03-16T15:03:22.891Z] TCP FIN from client
[2026-03-16T15:03:22.892Z] 499 client closed request
```
Julie (Support): Can you try repro steps with quick WiFi -> data flip? They did: 1) start stream; 2) after first tokens, toggle wifi off; 3) stream aborts.
Maya: Sounds like asymmetric NAT or client doesn't re-establish SSE. On our side 499 means client closed connection — we didn't send RST. Any proxies between client and our edge?
Devon: Customer is behind corp WiFi (captive) then hot-swaps to LTE. Mobile app doesn't re-open EventSource on 'online' event reliably.
Alex: Quick triage checklist for them to try: 1) reproduce with plain curl on phone (curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.com/v1/streams/chat) 2) enable client-level keepalive (send small heartbeat every 10s) 3) log network type change event.
Julie (Support): They tried curl on laptop and couldn't repro. Only happens on Android app. We asked for Android client logs and network state transitions.
Devon: On Android WebView/fetch there is known issue where sockets are torn down and not re-attached. We'll add a workaround: if 'online' event triggers, re-open connection after 200ms pause.
Maya: Also check edge idle timeout and keepalive passthrough. I reviewed request traces for that account: requests to /v1/streams/chat show no midstream error from our backend; last thing is the connection close from client side.
Alex: Customer worried about partial billing — confirmed tokens were counted up to last committed chunk; billing already handled by our billing pipeline but we'll confirm there was no double-charge.
Julie (Support): Action items: Devon to provide client patch for reconnection (DEV-7892), Maya to audit edge timeouts for that customer's region (EDGE-3451), Alex to confirm billing and update customer.
Devon: I'll push a staged Android fix and a sample repro app. Can you share exact repro device + OS? Julie: They reported Pixel 6a Android 14, carrier T-Mobile.
Maya: Meanwhile, recommend customer to add client-side retry/backoff and a short-living token refresh strategy. Also suggest measuring sequence numbers in SSE to resume partial bursts.
Alex: I'll reply to customer with repro checklist and ETA for mobile patch. Thanks all :thumbsup:
